text: ITEM 1 | About 11 cubed pieces of pale orange-to-peach flesh, with slightly deeper orange edges and a few greenish-cream rind edges. Cubes are roughly 2 cm per side, with one or two smaller pieces around 1 cm. Surface is matte and moist-looking, with firm, clean-cut edges and no browning, glaze, or cooking marks. Pieces sit loosely scattered on a white square plate with little visible juice or sauce. | 90
